title: Using ChatGPT to review our resume ✍️
description:
Does your resume show the skills that are most relevant for the job you're applying for? You want to make sure you're including the right skills for the job you're applying to—not everything you've ever done. So how do you know what relevant skills even are? Use the Teal Resume Builder OR use ChatGPT to find the skills that align with your work history and the job you're targeting. #resumebuilder #resumetips #resumetips
